detail.longDescription: I have worked with many young # IT coders who were raised on Python and adore its # syntax , but they could not countenance the offside rule syntax of Agda, Haskell, Hope, and other ML family of # programming languages that trace their syntax to Landin’s 1966 seminal FP language, ISWIM. Incidentally, this lot also deride the syntax of WASM, Clojure, Racket, Scheme, and other LISP family of languages. This syntactic sensitivity could limit these kids’ linguistic exposure and would ultimately curtail their technical careers. But then, their favourite # AI code generators are already doing that to them, so….🤷‍♂️ # LunchtimeLament
